notes.title: V.2.02.02 Update Log
notes.content:
[Adjustments]

 After clicking the "Sync Steam Achievements" button, not only can you sync local achievements to Steam achievements, but you can also sync Steam achievements to local achievements to help players who have lost their saves complete their game achievements.

[Fixes]

 Fixed an issue where the names of the daughter and father were incorrectly displayed as their initial names in some text.
 Fixed an issue where, after enabling Steam Cloud Saves, the game would fail to launch due to missing files from old save versions.


 If you need assistance after losing your save, please package your save folder and send it to the following email: eggHatcherFeedback@outlook.com
 How to retrieve your save files:
Press Win + R on your keyboard and type AppData.
Go to:\LocalLow\EggHatcher\VolcanoPrincess 
 (Regarding save issues, we will try our best to assist you. If you do not receive a prompt response, please send email again to remind us. Thank you very much for your patience and understanding!)


 Fixed an issue where the "Bard" would appear simultaneously at the restaurant and the harbor in March of Summer Fire Year.
 Due to item name conflicts, the newly added "Heartbreak Potion" in version V2.01.13 has been renamed to "Broken Potion."
 Some main storyline dialogues have been refined in translation.


Fixed several text issues caused by English translation document revisions after the V2.01.13 :

 Fixed an issue with the dialogue options about working with the daughter in March of Summer Fire Year.
 Fixed incorrect text in the time UI in the upper-left corner and the scheduling page UI.
 Fixed an issue where only "Proposal" was shown when challenging someone.
 Fixed other text issues.


If you encounter any bugs after the update, please feel free to report them through the following methods. We will prioritize fixing them, and we greatly appreciate your support!

1. Fill out the Bug report survey: Survey Link
2. Send bug reports to: eggHatcherFeedback@outlook.com

notes.title: V.2.02.01 Update Log
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Steam Cloud is back online!
This update increases the number of save slots to 24, improves the save file structure, then enhancing the stability of the cloud save feature.

Note:
After updating to version 2.02, when you first launch the new version of the game, old version save files will automatically be moved to the "OldVersionArchives" folder in the save directory for backup. It is also recommended that you manually back up your save files before launching the new version of the game.

How to retrieve your save files:
Press Win+R on your keyboard and type AppData.
Go to \LocalLow\EggHatcher\VolcanoPrincess.

 *If you have previously played on multiple devices using the same account, it is recommended to first disable cloud save for backup, and then enable cloud save when launching the game.
 *If you wish to play an older version, move the old save files back to the original "VolcanoPrincess" folder.

Previously, since save files were stored in AppData/LocalLow, players who hadn’t logged in for a long time might have triggered Windows 10/11's automatic cleanup function. We sincerely apologize for this!

If you encounter any issues with save file updates or while playing after Steam Cloud has been enabled, we kindly ask that you submit a bug report to help us improve. Thank you very much!

Other updates in V2.02.01:
[Adjustments]

 The EXP reward for the "Intermediate Knight" task in the Lord's quest has been increased from 50 to 60 experience points.(Note: If players encounter a situation where their Lord's experience is 480/500 and all tasks are completed but they cannot level up, we will provide a fix. Please send your save file in a package to: egghatcher@foxmail.com)
 A new initialization loading prompt screen has been added when launching the game.
 The backpack sorting system has been updated to sort items based on both type and price.


[Fixes]

 Fixed an issue where enemies did not drop gold and reputation during Dark Alleys battles.
 Fixed an issue where some enemies dropped excessive gold during Dark Alleys battles.
 Fixed an issue in the alchemy room interface where buttons could still be clicked when there was not enough money.
 Fixed an issue where the Scholar event in September of Autumn Fire Year appeared on two maps simultaneously.
 Fixed an issue where random events in the bathhouse job did not correctly increase Fame.
 Fixed various text display errors.
 Fixed an issue where the item count in the collection room showed 290 instead of the correct amount.


If you encounter any bugs after the update, please feel free to report them through the following methods. We will prioritize fixing them, and we greatly appreciate your support!

1. Fill out the Bug report survey: Survey Link
2. Send bug reports to: egghatcher@foxmail.com

notes.title: Forecast on Major Update & Japanese Language
notes.content:
Dear parents,

Children's Day is coming soon! Happy Children's Day in advance to all of our players!
We have 2 things to announce to you today:

A. Major Update - New Romance Endings, and Lebsa Event modification
Volcano Princess will have its first major update on May 31.
Besides the fixes and balances, the main changes are:

1- A new revision and interpretation of the [spoiler]Lebsa Event[/spoiler].
The developers attach great importance to player's feedbacks. They heard the voices that the [spoiler]Lebsa Event[/spoiler] took place too fast and sharp to accept, so they decided to modify the narrative of the event. Besides, they are adding more explainations and details in the plot to make the story happen more smoothly.
More than 10 drawings are added for this modification.

New CG preview:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859998/d3a53d7c4949148f2ce01051e41e0b19829fc50a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859998/94c8bf3e1020cc53d605de5c5056051b5181bdd5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859998/f0a345860b229f5488f1fb77a288c1f2e376a84f.jpg


2 - Three New Multi-NPC Romance Endings
The three new romance endings are:
A. [spoiler]Ze & Hackett & Daughter[/spoiler]
B. [spoiler]Lon & Craig & Daughter[/spoiler]
C. [spoiler]Gwyneth & Mona & Daughter[/spoiler]

Japanese version will launch!
Japanese will be installed in mid to late June. We will inform the exact date in advance so please stay tuned with us!


Thank you support! If you meet any bugs, please submit a Gle Form. And welcome to the official Discord!

notes.title: IMPORTANT TO DO before starting the game! [after v1.00.09] and some forecast
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm Mien from the publisher team. A FAQ is planned in some hours but I believe here are some very important points the players need to be told at first place:

First of all, we need to say sorry about the bugs. The devs were continuously working on savedata system and bugs, but it seems not progress smoothly at v1.00.09. So there's still things important to know for the current version1.00.09:

Part 1: BEFORE THE GAME
Please shut down the Steam Cloud of Volcano Princess Because of a bug that may break the savedata . 
The devs are still looking for a way to fix it, for now PLEASE MAKE SURE to follow these step before you start the game:

1. Uninstall the DEMO version (if any) 
2. Turn off the Steam Cloud function
Library => right click Volcano Princess => Properties => General => Cancel the 3rd tick (cloud archive)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859998/2a7ec3ae9c6e2e8885dd0feca9a75ef6fdf873d3.png
3. DELETE EVERYTHING in this folder before you start a new game:
【SYSTEM DISK】\Users【Your Windows Username】\AppData\LocalLow\EggHatcher\VolcanoPrincess
(or copy this to the address line and press enter: %APPDATA%\..\LocalLow\EggHatcher\VolcanoPrincess)
4. Start the game.

Part2: Will-be fixed severe bugs
1. For version 1.00.09 there's a bug when receiving a letter from NPC: The gift/chioces will not appear and make the game freeze. 
It'll be fixed in next patch (Apr.24 day Beijing time). 
If you want to play the game before the patch, please keep these letters (you can still improve relationships with NPCs) until the patch, or switch to Chinese language version to open it instantly.

2. For version 1.00.09 there's a bug when first time go to catch a horse. It may cause a crash. Once you meet it and reloaded the game, it don't appear again.
It may will be fixed in the next patch. 

Part3: About the English texts
For the translation, we sincerely know there's still a lot to do with the English text. The translators are still working on it, and we are collecting feedback from sheets and Discord, The game has 300,000+ English word plots, and we will continuously improve it. 

Volcano Princess is the first game of the 2 devs from Egg Hatcher Studio, so it may take some time on debugging and text improvement implement. We are sorry for the bugs and text errors, and sincerely thank all the player's patience and support. Our team and the devs will make our best effort to make the game experience well.

Thank you for reading. See you in a few hours for the patch and FAQ!

Mien

If you meet any bugs, please submit a Gle Form. And welcome to our Discord!

notes.title: Volcano Princess will fully release on Apr.21!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!!
After months of recovering, development and polishing, we can finally announce today:

Volcano Princess will be fully release on April 21

Please take a look at this brand new trailer!

[previewyoutube=WPzzhcQBw9s;full][/previewyoutube]

We want to thank you all for your continuous support of the game.
Since our first announcement, we have received encouragement beyond the initial expectations. Can't fully express our appreciation to all of your feedbacks, support words and loves!
 
We would like to take this opportunity today to announce two new game features!

1. More than 50 kinds of game ending, a large number of beautiful CG waiting for you to collect!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859998/efbbf2f8e1c70924a4799d9c485206c0a79a498c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859998/7e1afe157cf8bbd79c9b053c8ff815571712a4d6.jpg
When the official version goes live on April 21, over 50 endings will be presented!
There are some we had not thought of the ending ......I hope you can enjoy it ^ ^
 
A small tip: relationship ending and career ending are separate!
 
2. Well-known voice actress Nakahara Mai starring for daughter to bring Japanese dubbing!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40859998/d6a9a441c6ae8c5661c785f63ed117a64d1bdd4e.png
Miss Nakahara Mai was famous for its performance in "CLANNED" and "Higurashi When They Cry". We are very grateful to be able to have the opportunity to work with her!
You can hear some of the voices in the trailer!

Please join us in looking forward to the launch of our daughter on April 21!
